title: Connect the newsroom image picker to shared image operations
description:
As a newsroom editor, I want the existing four-option picker to use the same image workflow as the CLI and MCP so that choices and image provenance agree across interfaces.

Feature: Newsroom image curation parity
  Scenario: Pick an image in the newsroom
    Given an editor opens image selection for a Story
    When they search and accept a candidate
    Then the picker applies it through the shared image workflow
    And preserves the existing search, reload, source credit and saved-cover behavior
  Scenario: Work with an agent's draft choice
    Given an agent selected a draft image for an item
    When the editor opens the item
    Then the editor can inspect and replace that selection

Support generated candidates when configured, while preserving an option to leave the existing placeholder. Keep publication-specific visual guidance in publication policy.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Build step 7 of the image toolchain: the newsroom generate panel uses the shared image operations and the review queue. Overlaps PPY-956dff (the four-option picker); build one panel against the shared operations, not two. See project/wiki/image-toolchain.md sections 8 and 9.
